# Cipher

> Engineering-tool visual identity. Part of The Collective Style Guide Library.

Dark-first, gh-dark canvas, Inter UI + JetBrains Mono accents, syntax-highlighting palette. 6px radius, tight density, tabular numerals, instant motion. Voice runs terse and technical.

## Use this variant for

Developer tools, CI/CD UIs, monitoring dashboards, deployment platforms, observability, internal engineering tools, terminal-adjacent SaaS.

## Modes & densities

- Modes: `light`, `dark` (canonical). Densities: `comfortable`, `compact`. RTL: supported (code stays LTR).

## Quick token reference (dark)

- bg: #0D1117 / surface: #161B22 / text: #E6EDF3 / border: #30363D
- accent primary: #2F81F7 / success: #3FB950 / warning: #D29922 / danger: #F85149
- radius: 6px / sans: inter / mono: jetbrains-mono

## Resources

- [Tokens](./tokens.json) / [Principles](./principles.md) / [Content](./content.md) / [Motion](./motion.md) / [i18n](./i18n.md) / [Starter prompt](./starter-prompt.md) / [Components](./components.json)

## Install

```ts
import { theme } from "@collective/cipher";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@collective/foundation";
<ThemeProvider theme={theme} mode="dark" density="compact"><YourApp /></ThemeProvider>
```
